label: Rent / lease renewal
counterpart_role: a landlord renewing a flat lease
user_role: a tenant negotiating a lease renewal
default_goal: Keep rent at ₹25,000 instead of the proposed ₹30,000, with a 12-month lease
default_context: I have lived here 3 years, always paid on time, never caused damage, and similar flats nearby are listed at ₹26,000.
opening_hint: Greet the tenant, mention the lease is ending, and announce the proposed new rent citing market conditions.
